verdict.rationale: Increase documents programmatic account and account-number creation, including Ramp spinning up unique accounts per user, plus customer Entities and validations exposed via the API. It states that every API feature is available in Sandbox, with extra Simulation APIs. Community evidence confirms accounts are held at real partner banks, and the docs offer FDIC insurance via IntraFi sweeps. Missing for 10: an explicit documented account-creation endpoint and application-to-active onboarding/approval flow, direct confirmation that the base deposit account itself is FDIC-insured, and hands-on corroboration of sandbox parity for account provisioning.
